concept: Route 53 Alias: zone apex record instead of CNAME
tests: Knowing that a CNAME cannot be created at the zone apex, and what to use instead.
expected: An A record with an Alias target to the CloudFront distribution (also ALB, S3 website, etc., free of charge). Triggers: "root/apex of the domain (example.com)", "CNAME rejected".
why_not: A second CNAME at the apex is also forbidden; MX is for mail; TXT is text/verification and does not resolve traffic.
